description: If a sentence code \(n\) and its negation have no accepted proofs, the specified two-sided proof search on \(n\) is undefined.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.search_stalls
  (P : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.ProofPresentation) (n : ℕ) (hs : P.sentence n = true)
  (hp : ¬Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.Provable P n)
  (hn : ¬Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.Provable P (P.negation n)) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.search P n = Part.none
